#Loading the dataset
```{r}

# Cluster-ordered CpG list
cpg_list <- c(
  "cg01409343", "cg18942579", "cg16936953", "cg12054453", "cg00490406",
  "cg01059398", "cg21979287", "cg08818207", "cg27537252", "cg03425812",
  "cg12828896", "cg03957124", "cg16306654", "cg03753191", "cg07878065",
  "cg04176813", "cg07839457", "cg16411857",  # Cluster 1
  "cg23387863", "cg23904266", "cg09249800", "cg11699125", "cg14496081",
  "cg07830828", "cg02068052",               # Cluster 2
  "cg24741430", "cg10636246", "cg13575798", "cg26140475", "cg09801824"   # Cluster 3
)

da.methylome_pheno
da.methylome_pheno_df <- as.data.frame(da.methylome_pheno)
head(da.methylome_pheno_df)

da.CpGs_INT
da.CpGs_df <- as.data.frame(da.CpGs_INT)
da.CpGs_df$id <- rownames(da.CpGs_df)
View(da.CpGs_df)


da.ratio_kt
da.ratio_kt_df <- as.data.frame(da.ratio_kt)

ewas_reg_cpgs <- da.CpGs_df[, c(cpg_list, "id")]
View(ewas_reg_cpgs)


#Extract outcomes of interest and covariates for the regression analysis
ewas_reg_outcome <- da.methylome_pheno_df[,c("id","egfrcrcys_v5","GENDER51","CENTER","V5AGE51","RACEGRP51", "acr_v5")]
View(ewas_reg_outcome)

ewas_merged <- merge(ewas_reg_outcome, ewas_reg_cpgs, by = "id")
View(ewas_merged)

incidents <- read_dta("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/inc_esrd_by20.dta")
View(incidents)
colnames(incidents)

# Merge using a left join: keep all rows in ewas_merged
ewas_merged <- merge(ewas_merged, incidents, by = "id", all.x = TRUE)

View(ewas_merged)

#Change eGFR into low eGFR
ewas_merged$low_eGFR <- -1 * ewas_merged$egfrcrcys_v5

#inverse normal transformation of 
invnorm_transform <- function(x) {
  qnorm((rank(x, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x)))
}
ewas_merged$low_egfr_INT <- invnorm_transform(ewas_merged$low_eGFR)
ewas_merged$acr_INT <- invnorm_transform(ewas_merged$acr_v5)

```





```{r cars}

# ESRD Cox model (WHITE only)
cox_results <- lapply(cpg_list, function(cpg) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(fu_esrd50_def1_v1, inc_esrd50crcys_def1_v5) ~ ", 
                               cpg, " + GENDER51 + V5AGE51 + CENTER"))
  model <- coxph(formula, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "W"))
  coef <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if (cpg %in% rownames(coef)) {
    row <- coef[cpg, ]
    return(data.frame(CpG = cpg, Outcome = "ESRD", Beta = row["coef"], pValue = row["Pr(>|z|)"]))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})
esrd_df <- do.call(rbind, cox_results)

# ------------------------
# Linear model: low eGFR (WHITE only)
egfr_results <- lapply(cpg_list, function(cpg) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("low_egfr_INT ~ ", cpg, " + V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER"))
  model <- lm(formula, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "W"))
  coef <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if (cpg %in% rownames(coef)) {
    row <- coef[cpg, ]
    return(data.frame(CpG = cpg, Outcome = "low_eGFR", Beta = row["Estimate"], pValue = row["Pr(>|t|)"]))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})
egfr_df <- do.call(rbind, egfr_results)

# ------------------------
# Linear model: ACR (WHITE only)
uacr_results <- lapply(cpg_list, function(cpg) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("acr_INT ~ ", cpg, " + V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER"))
  model <- lm(formula, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "W"))
  coef <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if (cpg %in% rownames(coef)) {
    row <- coef[cpg, ]
    return(data.frame(CpG = cpg, Outcome = "uACR", Beta = row["Estimate"], pValue = row["Pr(>|t|)"]))
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
})
uacr_df <- do.call(rbind, uacr_results)

# ------------------------
# Combine results and prepare for heatmap
plot_df <- bind_rows(egfr_df, uacr_df, esrd_df) %>%
  mutate(
    Signif = ifelse(pValue < 0.05, "*", ""),
    CpG = factor(CpG, levels = cpg_list),
    Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = c("low_eGFR", "uACR", "ESRD"))
  )


plot_df$CpG <- factor(plot_df$CpG, levels = rev(cpg_list))
plot_df$Outcome <- recode(plot_df$Outcome,
                          "low_eGFR" = "Low eGFR",
                          "uACR" = "uACR",
                          "ESRD" = "ESRD")



# ------------------------
# Plot heatmap
heatmap <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Outcome, y = CpG, fill = Beta)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = Signif), size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0,
    name = "Beta Coefficient"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CpG Associations with Kidney Outcomes (White Participants)",
    caption = "* denotes p < 0.05",
    x = "Outcome", y = "CpG Site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )

# ------------------------

# dev.copy2pdf()

# Save the figure
ggsave("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/04 Plots/final_heatmap.png", 
       plot = heatmap, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)


```

```{r}

# Step 1: Pivot beta values to wide format
beta_wide <- plot_df %>%
  select(CpG, Outcome, Beta) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Outcome, values_from = Beta, names_prefix = "Beta_")

# Step 2: Pivot p-values to wide format
pval_wide <- plot_df %>%
  select(CpG, Outcome, pValue) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Outcome, values_from = pValue, names_prefix = "pval_")

# Step 3: Merge them
full_table <- left_join(beta_wide, pval_wide, by = "CpG")

# Step 4: (Optional) Arrange by your designated order
full_table <- full_table %>%
  mutate(CpG = factor(CpG, levels = cpg_list)) %>%
  arrange(CpG)

print(full_table)

```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
